settings.migrateCompendiaHint: Migrates compendium data to the latest version. Meant for developers only. If you don't know what this does, you really shouldn't click it. Seriously. Don't.
settings.debugMessagesHint: Enable additional debug logging and messages.
settings.phenotypesHint: In Hyperborean scholarship, the primary zoological or morphological descriptor of a creature. Occasionally used to determine whether a magic weapon, spell, or armour does special damage to the creature, or provides protection from attacks by the creature, etc.
settings.characterClassesHint: Character classes available to PCs and some NPCs.
settings.enableTurnTrackerHint: Enable the Turn Tracker app, which allows you to track exploration turns.
settings.autoCalcAcHint: Use 'equipped' status of armour and shields to calculate AC & MV. N.B.: This function may not work correctly with certain magic item combinations, depending on whether or not they should stack with other protective items. But the majority of cases should work correctly.
settings.quickCreateCharsHint: Enable the Quick Create Characters button on the Character sheet by selecting a Method. All stats are rolled down-the-line, and the system will re-roll until it gets a set that meets class requirements.
settings.customCompendiaHint: Comma-separated list of your compendia for armor, equipment, and weapons. This allows you to use your own compendia with the character quick-create feature.
settings.enableAttrChecksHint: This option allows players to click an attribute name to do a 3d6 concentration (roll-under) check. N.B.: This is an optional rule, and is disabled by default.
settings.flipRollUnderMods: Reverse situational modifiers on roll-under checks
settings.flipRollUnderModsHint: For roll-under checks, reverse the sign on situational modifiers so that a positive number is treated as a bonus (subtracted from the roll) and a negative number is treated as a penalty (added to the roll). Other modifiers applied from attributes or items are automatically handled this way.
settings.resizeTokens: Resize Small and Large NPC tokens
settings.resizeTokensHint: When loading the game world, scan the actors directory and update prototypeToken information for Small and Large NPCs. Disabled by default.
settings.isGroupInitiativeHint: Hyperborea 3rd Edition (as written) uses group-based initiative. Disabling this item reverts the system to Foundry's default behavior of individual initiative.
settings.rerollInitiativeHint: Keeps, resets or rerolls initiative each round.
settings.limitMovementHint: Limit token movement to MV speed for all actors. Disabled by default.
settings.forceRangeLimitHint: For PCs, prevent a weapon or spell attack if it is out of range. Disabled by default.
settings.forceWeaponEquipHint: For PCs, prevent item use or weapon attack if it is not equipped. NPCs/monsters are not affected by this setting. Disabled by default.
settings.forceSpellMemorizeHint: For PCs, prevent a spell being cast if it is not memorized. NPCs/monsters are not affected by this setting. Disabled by default.
settings.enableCombatSitModDetectionHint: The system will try to automatically detect and calculate situational attack modifiers based on a number of token effects, token elevation, etc. Disabled by default.
settings.enableEncumbranceHint: Enables the following GM-defined Strength multipliers as encumbrance formulae, to enforce MV and AC penalties. Disabled by default.
settings.encumbranceLabelHint: A whole number, e.g. 10, 15, etc. This is only used if Encumbrance is enabled, above.
settings.critHitsHint: Show buttons to roll critical hits on natural 20.
settings.critMissHint: Show buttons to roll critical miss on natural 1.
settings.damageTypes: Additional damage types for weapons and spells
settings.damageTypesHint: These will be appended to the existing system list. The current damage types include Basic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire, Gas, Negative Energy, Pain, Poison, and Positive Energy.

details.rollHDLong: Roll the NPCs HP when a token is created based on the HD

simple.name: Simple
simple.hint: Examples: Climbing natural/rough surface with light or no armour...

moderate.name: Moderate
moderate.hint: Examples: Climbing natural/rough surface with medium armour...

challenging.name: Challenging
challenging.hint: Examples: Climbing natural/rough surface with heavy armour; hear loud noise...

difficult.name: Difficult
difficult.hint: Examples: Non-thief hear quiet noise; find concealed or secret door...

veryDifficult.name: Very Difficult
veryDifficult.hint: Examples: Non-thief pick lock; find trap...

attributes.equipped: The Equipped tag allows this item to be equipped and unequipped.
attributes.carried: The Carried tag allows this item to be carried or dropped.
attributes.isConsumable: The Consumable tag gives this item the increment/decrement buttons.
attributes.isAmmunition: The Ammunition tag causes this item to display on the Combat tab.
attributes.isLightSource: The Light Source tag allows this item to be used as a light source.
attributes.lightRadius: Distance of light emission. Bright must be included within the radius of dim light.
attributes.lightAngle: Limit the angle of emission for this light source.
attributes.lightColor: Coloration applied to this light source.
attributes.lightDuration: Duration in rounds (roll formula allowed) for a light source. Leave blank if permanent.
attributes.isContainer: The Container tag allows this item to contain other non-container items.
attributes.duration: Duration in rounds (numbers only) for a conjured or ephemeral item. Leave blank if permanent.
attributes.hasSpells: The Has Spells tag allows this item to have one or more spells as usable powers.

attributes.isConsumable: Note: Leave this item checked unless the spell is being used as an at-will power.

attributes.usesAmmo: The Uses Ammo tag allows this item to decrement ammunition on attacks.
attributes.isGrenade: The Grenade tag causes this item to attack as a hurled item, from Table 143 of the Player's Manual.
attributes.isAreaEffect: The Area Effect tag causes this item ignore making an attack roll, and simply roll damage. Note that this is different from the Grenade tag, above.

annotations.ignoreShieldAc: Ignores AC bonus provided by opponent's shield (if any).
annotations.p1VsPlate: +1 'to hit' opponents wearing plate mail, field plate, or full plate.
annotations.1hOr2h: Melee weapon may be wielded one- or two-handed. If the weapon can also be hurled, use one-handed damage.
annotations.true2Hand: A 'true' two-handed melee weapon; must be wielded with two hands.
annotations.hurled: Melee weapon may be hurled one-handed; strength damage adjustment applies.
annotations.p1VsMelee: +1 AC bonus versus melee attacks; quarterstaff must be wielded with two hands; tonfa and hand trident must be dual wielded (one in each hand).
annotations.dblDmgVsCharge: Double damage dice (apply modifiers after) when set to receive a charge.
annotations.dismountRider: Weapon has a 4-in-6 chance to dismount a rider on a natural 19 or 20 attack roll.
annotations.dblDmgFromCharge: Double damage dice (apply modifiers after) when used from a charging mount.
annotations.d10FromWarhorse: Base damage improves to 1d10 when mounted on a heavy warhorse.
annotations.strDmgIfCustomized: Strength damage adjustment applies only if draw weight is adjusted for the archer.

critMiss.name: Critical Miss
critMiss.stumble: Awkward stumble. One adjacent gets one free attack. No further attacks for rest of round.
critMiss.tripFall: Trip and fall. Prone: -4 AC, no DX bonus for remainder of round and until next action.
critMiss.hitAlly: Hit ally: closest for melee, closest adjacent for ranged. Regular hit.
critMiss.hitAllyCrit: Hit ally: closest for melee, closest adjacent for ranged. Critical Hit.

classEditor.xpBonusReqsNote: Minimum attribute scores required to earn a 10% bonus to XP.
classEditor.extrFeatReqsNote: Some classes get a +8% bonus on one or two physical feats.
classEditor.spellListsNote: If the class can cast spells, make one or two selections here.
classEditor.saveThrowsNote: Note: Most classes get a +2 bonus on two of their saving throws.
classEditor.startingPackNote: Define the starting equipment pack for this class.
